FAIL.summary: One or more configured redirect addresses are malformed or do not meet the configured transport rules.
actions: Find the invalid addresses in the collected details and confirm which object owns them.

For web, SPA or native registrations, open App registrations > this application > Authentication. For SAML reply URLs, open Enterprise applications > this application > Single sign-on > Basic SAML Configuration.

Replace invalid or non-HTTPS production addresses with the exact approved callback addresses, coordinating the change with the application team. Localhost HTTP and supported native-app schemes are evaluated separately by the report.
Save and run the report again. A service with no redirect address does not need an invented URL to pass.
